CREATE View [dbo].[ContractViewWithPaid]    
as    
SELECT    (isnull(finaltotal,0) - isnull(shippingPrice,0)) totalbeforshippingPrice,    
convert(nvarchar, autoNumber) +CONVERT(nvarchar, IsNull('----'+ Ordernumber,'')) as ShowLabel   ,CONVERT(bit, iif(finaltotal > totalPaid, 0, 1)) AS IsRecivedMony, *    
FROM            (SELECT        isnull(finaltotal, 0) - isnull(PoPaid, 0) - isnull(totalPayment, 0) - isnull(SuppPOPaid, 0) AS remindpaid, isnull(PoPaid, 0) + isnull(totalPayment, 0) + isnull(SuppPOPaid, 0) totalPaid, *    
                          FROM            (SELECT        EInvoiceSubmissionId, EInvoiceUuid, EInvoiceLongId, ContractID, ContractDate, UnRelaied, ContractAmountwTax, ContractNote, ContractAmountWoTax, ContractType, CustomerID, ContractEnddate, Istender, Note2, SetupDate,     
                         SetupNote, CustomerAccountName, Gov, CustomerAccountAddress, CustomerAccountCity,CardID,religion,CategoryID, CustomerAccountMobile1, Phone2, Phone3, Phone4, CustomerAccountTelephone2, CustomerAccountEmail, isContracted, CandidateID,     
                         CodeiD, GovName, AreaName, TypeName, CustomerAccount, MonyAccount, ProductAccount, SalesAccount, Department, IsInstall, ISCancel, PrintID, SupplierMony, ModifyAt, CreateAt, ModifyBy, CreateBy, StoreID, AutoNumber,     
                         Discount, CurrancyID, CurrancyEX, Ordernumber, POPaid, TotalOrder, TotalCurrancy, DiscountCurrancy, POPaidCurrancy, SalesMan, SalesManName, ComID, Tax, TaxCurrancy, AddTaxCurrancy, AddTax, TotalOrderBefor,     
                         TotalBeforCurrancy, ConName, IsResale, IsRecived, SalesTupeID, shippingPrice, ContractQuantity, EmpPointOfSaleID, Voucher, FullDesciption,FullDesciption2, IsVisitCall, finaltotal, IsPaid, SupplyOrderMasterID, TypeAutoNumber, Note1
  
,     
                         SafeAccount, IsService, PaymentMethod, CostItemId, Note3, Note4, Note5, Note6, Note7, Note8, Note9, Note10, Code, SalerImage, Rout, DepartmentId, STName, SName, remind, CustomerSalsMan, SOMName,     
                         TotalAfterDiscount, SuppPOPaid, Note13, IsCanceled, Note14, TaxDetailTotal, DiscountDetailTotal, UnElectronicInvoice, Note11, Note12, Note15, Note16, Note17, Note18, Note19, Note20, finalValue, EmpIndexString,     
                         CustomerSalesManID, ContractProjectID,   
                             (SELECT        SUM(Recivemony) AS Expr1    
                               FROM            PaymentRecive    
                               WHERE        (DetailContractId = ContractView.ContractID)) AS totalPayment    
FROM            ContractView) AS tab) AS ta

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[salessystemcontract]      
AS      
SELECT  ISNULL(CAST((row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dbo.SystemsContract.SystemID)) AS int), 0) AS EDMXID,       
Product.IsSurgery, Product.IsSales,Product.SupplierID,      
ProccessNumber, SystemsContract.SystemID,SystemsContract.CostCenterID , Product .ProName, SystemsContract.ProductID,       
SystemsContract.UnitePrice, Product .ProID, '-' + CONVERT(nvarchar, dbo.Employee.EmployeeID) + '-' + CONVERT(nvarchar, dbo.CustomerAccount.SalesMan) + '-' AS empPerm, Product .ProName AS Expr1, Product .ProPrice,       
Product .ProCost, Product .ProParent, Product .Description, Product .Prolevel, Product .Modality, Product .ISCall, Product .Size, Contract.ContractID, Contract.ContractDate, Contract.ContractAmountwTax, Contract.ContractNote,       
Contract.FarmingSupplyMasterId,      
Contract.ContractAmountWoTax, Contract.ContractType, Contract.CustomerID, Contract.ContractEnddate, Contract.Istender, Contract.SetupDate, Contract.SetupNote, ConType.TypeName, Contract.ISCancel, Contract.IsInstall,       
Contract.SupplierMony, Contract.ModifyAt, Contract.CreateBy, Contract.CreateAt, Contract.ModifyBy, Contract.StoreID, Contract.AutoNumber, Contract.Discount, Contract.CurrancyID, Contract.CurrancyEX, Contract.Ordernumber,       
Contract.POPaid,Contract.UnRelaied, Contract.TotalOrder, Contract.TotalCurrancy, Contract.DiscountCurrancy, Contract.POPaidCurrancy, ConType.ComID, Product .ProCost AS Cost, SystemsContract.Qty, SystemsContract.UnitID, Units.UName,       
SystemsContract.PriceCurrancy, SystemsContract.BatchNumber,Contract.SalesMan, SystemsContract.SecQuntity, SystemsContract.SecUnit, Employee.EmployeeNameA, CustomerAccount.CustomerAccountName, CustomerAccount.CustomerAccountMobile1,       
CustomerAccount.CategoryID, CustomerAccount.CustomerAccountAddress, CustomerAccount.Gov,CustomerAccount.CardName, Currancy.CName, Contract.Tax, Contract.TaxCurrancy, Contract.AddTax, Contract.AddTaxCurrancy, Contract.SalesTupeID,       
contract.TotalOrder - isnull(Contract.Tax, 0) - isnull(Contract.AddTax, 0) - isnull(Contract.POPaid, 0) + isnull(Contract.shippingPrice, 0) - isnull(Contract.Voucher, 0) AS finalTotal, Contract.shippingPrice, Contract.TotalOrderBefor,       
CustomerAccount.DepartmentId, Contract.TotalBeforCurrancy, ConType.IsResale, SystemsContract.ColorID, SystemsContract.DimantionID, SystemsContract.SizeID, SystemsContract.InsuranceLimitStart, SystemsContract.Expirdate,       
SystemsContract.Description AS systemDescription, SystemsContract.Cost AS systemCost, Contract.Voucher, SystemsContract.StoreID AS SystemStore, SystemsContract.VisitPriceInInsurance, SystemsContract.SerialNumber,       
Gov.GovName, Area.AreaName,Area.AreaID, CustomerAccount.CustomerAccountTelephone2, ConType.ReceiptAdress, ConType.ReceiptFooter, ConType.ReceiptName, ConType.ReceiptPhone, ConType.Logo, SystemsContract.UsedFromInsurance,       
SystemsContract.InsuranceLimit, SystemsContract.HasInstallationVisit, SystemsContract.InsuranceEndDate, SystemsContract.ProDiscount, SystemsContract.ProPriceBeforDeiscount, SystemsContract.ProDiscountPercent,       
Contract.SupplyOrderMasterID, SystemsContract.InsuranceStartDate, SystemsContract.DeliveryDate, SystemsContract.EndVisitsDate, SystemsContract.IsGenerated, Color.CName AS ColorName, Sizes.SName AS SizeName,       
SystemsContract.NonActiveSystem, Contract.TypeAutoNumber, '' AS PPIName, 0 AS PPIID, 0 AS Code, Contract.SafeAccount, SystemsContract.VisitPriceOutInsurance, SystemsContract.TransportionPriceInsuranse,       
SystemsContract.TransportionPriceOutInsuranse, Contract.Note1, Contract.Note2, Contract.Note3, Contract.Note4, Contract.Note5, Contract.Note6, Contract.Note7, Contract.Note8, Contract.Note9, Contract.Note10, CONVERT(bit, 0)       
AS WillFactor, CONVERT(int, NULL) AS ProductProcessItem, SystemsContract.Width, SystemsContract.Hight, SystemsContract.length, SystemsContract.Density, Contract.CostItemId, Contract.IsPaid, Cost * Qty AS TotalCost, Contract.Note11,       
Contract.Note12, Contract.Note13, Contract.Note14, Contract.Note15, Contract.Note16, Contract.Note17, Contract.Note18, Contract.Note19, Contract.Note20, PriceCurrancy * Qty AS Total,(PriceCurrancy * Qty)-isnull( SystemsContract.DiscountDetailValue,0) AS Totalafterdetaildiscount,      
(PriceCurrancy * Qty)-isnull( SystemsContract.DiscountDetailValue,0) +isnull( SystemsContract.TaxDetailValue,0) AS TotalafterdetailTax, (PriceCurrancy * Qty) - (Cost * Qty) AS Profit,       
'' AS CurrentQTY, EngWeight, ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.EngWeight > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.EngWeight, 1), 1) * ISNULL(dbo.SystemsContract.SecQuntity, 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.length > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.length,       
1), 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Hight > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Hight, 1), 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Density > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Density, 1), 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Width > 0,       
dbo.SystemsContract.Width, 1), 1) AS GuideWeight, ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.EngWeight > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.EngWeight, 1), 1) * ISNULL(dbo.SystemsContract.SecQuntity, 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.length > 0,       
dbo.SystemsContract.length, 1), 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Hight > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Hight, 1), 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Density > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Density, 1), 1)       
* ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Width > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Width, 1), 1) * SystemsContract.PriceCurrancy AS GuidePrice, dbo.SystemsContract.Qty - ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.EngWeight > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.EngWeight,       
1), 1) * ISNULL(dbo.SystemsContract.SecQuntity, 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.length > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.length, 1), 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Hight > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Hight, 1), 1)       
* ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Density > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Density, 1), 1) * ISNULL(iif(dbo.SystemsContract.Width > 0, dbo.SystemsContract.Width, 1), 1) AS DifQty, Store.SName AS StoreName, contract.AllowedDayes, finePrice,       
contract.IsService, MinimumMounthly, ForEachDays, Contract.IsActive, DaysName =      
    (SELECT        CONVERT(nvarchar, d .ArabicDayName) + ','      
      FROM            [day] d JOIN      
                                contractDay cd ON d .DayID = cd.DayId      
      WHERE        cd.contractId = Contract.ContractID FOR xml path('')), Contract.EmpRecivePaymentId, Product .ModalityName, Product .CategoryName, Product .CategoryID AS ProductCategory, Product .CompanyID, product .CompanyName,       
product .Barcode, CustomerAccount.code AS CustomerCode, store.SName, SystemsContract.IsShipable, product .Note, IsSystemResale, dbo.contract.SuplayOrderPoPaid, CustomerAccount.SalesMan AS CustomerSalesManId,       
CustomerSalesEmp.EmployeeNameA AS CustomerSalesName, CustomerSalesEmp.EmpIndexString AS HPerm, Contract.InstallSetupId, ISMonth, ISStartDate, ISNumber, contract.DiscountPercent,contract.IsCanceled,SystemsContract.TaxDetailPercent,      
SystemsContract.TaxDetailValue,SystemsContract.DiscountDetailPercent,SystemsContract.DiscountDetailValue,SystemsContract.GroupProductKey,      
Contract.TaxDetailTotal,Contract.DiscountDetailTotal,lastDate,lastPrice,bonus,ISNULL(ItemDiscount,DiscountDetailValue/Qty)as ItemDiscount,(PriceCurrancy-ISNULL(ItemDiscount,DiscountDetailValue/Qty)) NetItemPrice,CustomerAccount.CodeiD,CustomerAccount.Place ,Contract.PaymentType      
,PriceCurrancy + iif(TaxDetailValue >0,TaxDetailValue/qty,0) as UnitPriceAfterTax,Product.SName SupplierName,contractBillId,Contract.IsBreakAllowance      
,Contract.GlassType, Product .PurchCode,Contract.SupplyOrderMasterID supplyerOrderId,SystemsContract.NoSalesTax,      
ConType.EInvoiceIsCredit, ConType.EInvoiceIsDepit,  
Contract.ContractProjectID,SystemsContract.DetailProjectID  , SystemsContract.SupplyOrderDetailID, --new
CASE 
    WHEN Product.SecoundUnit = SystemsContract.UnitID 
	then Product.UQuntity 
	else 1
	End as UnitFactor ,
 CASE 
    WHEN Product.SecoundUnit = SystemsContract.UnitID 
    THEN ISNULL(Product.UQuntity,1) * SystemsContract.Qty 
    ELSE 1 * SystemsContract.Qty
END as QuantityInBaseUnit, -- new By Amr 
CASE 
    WHEN Product.SecoundUnit = SystemsContract.UnitID 
	then isnull( Product.ProCost,0) * ( ISNULL(Product.UQuntity,1) * SystemsContract.Qty )
	else isnull( Product.ProCost,0) * 1 * SystemsContract.Qty 
	END as  TotalCostWithUnitFactor
FROM            Gov INNER JOIN      
                         Area ON Gov.AreaID = Area.AreaID RIGHT OUTER JOIN      
        CustomerAccount LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         Employee AS CustomerSalesEmp ON CustomerAccount.SalesMan = CustomerSalesEmp.EmployeeID RIGHT OUTER JOIN      
                         Contract INNER JOIN      
                         SystemsContract INNER JOIN      
                         ProductView AS Product ON SystemsContract.ProductID = Product .ProID ON Contract.ContractID = SystemsContract.ContractID ON CustomerAccount.CustomerAccountID = Contract.CustomerID LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         Employee ON Contract.SalesMan = Employee.EmployeeID LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         Store ON Contract.StoreID = Store.SID LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         Sizes ON SystemsContract.SizeID = Sizes.SID LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         Color ON SystemsContract.ColorID = Color.CID ON Gov.GOVID = CustomerAccount.Gov LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         Units ON SystemsContract.UnitID = Units.UID LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         ConType ON Contract.ContractType = ConType.ContractTypeID LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                         Currancy ON Contract.CurrancyID = Currancy.CID      
WHERE        (Contract.ISCancel = 0) OR      
                         (Contract.ISCancel IS NULL)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[SystemsContractStoreView]      AS      
SELECT        dbo.SystemsContractView.EDMXID, dbo.SystemsContractView.SystemID, dbo.SystemsContractView.InsuranceEndDate, dbo.SystemsContractView.InsuranceStartDate, dbo.SystemsContractView.InsuranceStatus,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.HasInstallationVisit, dbo.SystemsContractView.EndVisitsDate, dbo.SystemsContractView.IsGenerated, dbo.SystemsContractView.UsedFromInsurance, dbo.SystemsContractView.SerialNumber,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.DeliveryDate, dbo.SystemsContractView.InsuranceLimitStart, dbo.SystemsContractView.InsuranceLimit, dbo.SystemsContractView.ProName, dbo.SystemsContractView.ProductID,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.UnitePrice, dbo.SystemsContractView.ProID, dbo.SystemsContractView.Expr1, dbo.SystemsContractView.ProPrice, dbo.SystemsContractView.ProCost, dbo.SystemsContractView.ProParent,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.Description, dbo.SystemsContractView.Prolevel, dbo.SystemsContractView.Modality, dbo.SystemsContractView.ISCall, dbo.SystemsContractView.Size, dbo.SystemsContractView.ContractID,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.ContractDate, dbo.SystemsContractView.ContractAmountwTax, dbo.SystemsContractView.ContractNote, dbo.SystemsContractView.ContractAmountWoTax, dbo.SystemsContractView.IsService,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.ContractType, dbo.SystemsContractView.CustomerID, dbo.SystemsContractView.ContractEnddate, dbo.SystemsContractView.Istender, dbo.SystemsContractView.Note2, dbo.SystemsContractView.Note7,      
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.SetupDate, dbo.SystemsContractView.SetupNote, dbo.SystemsContractView.TypeName, dbo.SystemsContractView.ISCancel, dbo.SystemsContractView.IsInstall,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.SupplierMony, dbo.SystemsContractView.ModifyAt, dbo.SystemsContractView.CreateBy, dbo.SystemsContractView.CreateAt, dbo.SystemsContractView.ModifyBy, dbo.SystemsContractView.StoreID, dbo.SystemsContractView.MatrialID,      
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.AutoNumber, dbo.SystemsContractView.Discount, dbo.SystemsContractView.CurrancyID, dbo.SystemsContractView.CurrancyEX, dbo.SystemsContractView.Ordernumber,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.POPaid, dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalOrder, dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalCurrancy, dbo.SystemsContractView.DiscountCurrancy, dbo.SystemsContractView.POPaidCurrancy,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.ComID, dbo.SystemsContractView.Cost,      
       CASE WHEN isnull(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsSystemResale, 0) = 0 THEN dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty ELSE 0 END AS Qty1,       
                         CASE WHEN dbo.SystemsContractView.IsSystemResale = 1 THEN dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty ELSE 0 END AS ReQty,      
       dbo.SystemsContractView.UnitID, dbo.SystemsContractView.UName,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.PriceCurrancy, dbo.SystemsContractView.SalesMan, dbo.SystemsContractView.SubCost, dbo.SystemsContractView.SecQuntity, dbo.SystemsContractView.SecUnit,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.EmployeeNameA, dbo.SystemsContractView.CustomerAccountName, dbo.SystemsContractView.CustomerAccountMobile1, dbo.SystemsContractView.CategoryID,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.CustomerAccountAddress, dbo.SystemsContractView.Gov, dbo.SystemsContractView.Tax, dbo.SystemsContractView.CName, dbo.SystemsContractView.TaxCurrancy, dbo.SystemsContractView.AddTax,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.AddTaxCurrancy, dbo.SystemsContractView.SalesTupeID, dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalOrderBefor, dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalBeforCurrancy, dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.ColorID, dbo.SystemsContractView.DimantionID, dbo.SystemsContractView.GroupID, dbo.SystemsContractView.LastCommission, dbo.SystemsContractView.SizeID, dbo.SystemsContractView.Expirdate,       
                 dbo.SystemsContractView.SystemStore, dbo.SystemsContractView.ReceiptAdress, dbo.SystemsContractView.ReceiptFooter, dbo.SystemsContractView.ReceiptName, dbo.SystemsContractView.ReceiptPhone,       
                         dbo.SystemsContractView.Logo,       
       iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalSubCost*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalSubCost) TotalSubCost,  
    iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalCost*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.TotalCost) TotalCost,  
       iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.Total*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.Total) Total,       
       iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.SubProfit*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.SubProfit) SubProfit,   
    iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.Profit*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.Profit) Profit,  
       iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty) Qty,      
       iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.DiscountDetailValue*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.DiscountDetailValue) DiscountDetailValue,      
       iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.Totalafterdetaildiscount*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.Totalafterdetaildiscount) Totalafterdetaildiscount, 
	   ((iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.DiscountDetailValue*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.DiscountDetailValue))
	   /iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty)) ItemDiscountDetailValue,
	   (iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.Totalafterdetaildiscount*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.Totalafterdetaildiscount)
	   /iif(dbo.SystemsContractView.IsResale=1,(dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty*-1),dbo.SystemsContractView.Qty)) ItemTotalafterdetaildiscount,
       dbo.SystemsContractView.CurrentQTY,      
                         dbo.StoreView.SName, dbo.SystemsContractView.Description AS SytemDescription, dbo.SystemsContractView.IsSystemResale, dbo.SystemsContractView.empPerm,      
          dbo.SystemsContractView.CostCenterID      
FROM            dbo.SystemsContractView INNER JOIN      
                         dbo.StoreView ON dbo.SystemsContractView.SystemStore = dbo.StoreView.SID

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[SalesMonth]
AS
SELECT        SUM(iif(IsResale=1,TotalQTy*-1, TotalQTy)) AS TotalQTy, SUM(iif(IsResale=1,TotalOrder*-1,TotalOrder)) AS TotalOrder, SUM(iif(IsResale=1,TotalCost*-1,TotalCost)) AS TotalCost, SUM( iif(IsResale=1,profit*-1, profit)) AS profit, CONVERT(nvarchar(50), MONTH(ContractDate)) + '/' + CONVERT(nvarchar(50), YEAR(ContractDate)) 
                         AS MonthYear, ComID
FROM            dbo.ContarctReport

GROUP BY ComID, CONVERT(nvarchar(50), MONTH(ContractDate)) + '/' + CONVERT(nvarchar(50), YEAR(ContractDate))
